about.shortTitle: A lawyer by degree, a pastry chef by heart
about.short1: I'm Veldina - a law graduate who found her true passion in the kitchen. What started as a hobby and a few photos on Instagram grew into Eksplozija Slatkog.
about.short2: Every cake is handmade from fresh ingredients, with the same care I'd put into baking for my own family.
about.quote: It's not just a job - it's love that brings people together.
about.title: The story behind every cake
about.lead: From law school to a kitchen that smells of vanilla - meet the pastry chef behind Eksplozija Slatkog.
about.p1: I'm Veldina - a law graduate who found her true passion in the kitchen.
about.p2: While I was studying laws and paragraphs, I spent my weekends baking for family and friends. Every birthday, every celebration and every Sunday coffee was an excuse for a new cake. When I started posting photos on Instagram, I had no idea it would turn into a business.
about.p3: Today Eksplozija Slatkog is a small workshop of sweet moments in the heart of Mostar, followed by more than a hundred thousand people. I still do exactly what I did at the start: I bake by hand, from fresh ingredients, with no shortcuts - and I take every order personally.
about.p4: Thank you for being part of this story. I can't wait to make something special for your celebration, too.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: Short and clear: how this website handles your data.

a.title: No tracking
a.text: This site uses no tracking cookies, analytics or ads. We don't load any third-party scripts.

b.title: What's stored in your browser
b.text: Your basket, chosen language, theme and ticked recipe ingredients are stored only in your own browser (localStorage). This data never leaves your device, and you can delete it by clearing the site's data.

c.title: How your order is sent
c.text: When you send an order, the message opens in the app you choose (WhatsApp, Viber, Instagram or email). We don't store your data on a server - we only receive it through that message and use it solely to arrange your order.

d.title: Map and external links
d.text: The Google map on the Contact page only loads when you click it. Links to Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp lead to services with their own privacy policies.

e.title: Contact
e.text: For any questions about your data, write to us by email or on Instagram.
